questions.question: What does Proverbs 27 warn against boasting about?
options: Tomorrow, for you do not know what a day may bring
Your wealth, for it cannot possibly last forever
Your strength, for it surely fades with the passing years
Yesterday, for all of its glory is already long gone
questions.answer: Tomorrow, for you do not know what a day may bring

questions.question: How does Proverbs 27 say iron sharpens?
options: Iron dulls iron, and one man wears down another
Iron rusts in time, as a man grows idle
Iron sharpens stone, as the strong shape the weak
Iron sharpens iron, and one man sharpens another
questions.answer: Iron sharpens iron, and one man sharpens another

questions.question: Proverbs 27 says faithful are the wounds of a friend, but the kisses of an enemy are deceitful.
Do not boast about _____, for you do not know what a day may bring.
Iron sharpens iron, and one man sharpens _____.
